request.text: Oswin. I walked for forty years. Then I met a woman with a garden, and I stopped. She's gone now. The coal's going too. I'm tired. Sit. The fire's warm. That's all a man needs. Maud sent you? Maud's alive? Well. Of course she is. Spring. I meant to go. The roof needed mending, and then the garden. One more winter here. I'll walk in spring.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a plain rural English voice. Male, 65-75. Excellent quality. Persona: an old villager or craftsman who has settled down after a long life; homely, tired, set in his ways. Emotion: weary, gentle, grumbling, fond. A warm, round, slightly croaky old voice, unhurried and conversational, like an old man by his own hearth; soft and close when he writes in his journal.
